step.sources.title: Where offers come from
step.email.title: Connect your email
step.backup.title: Save a recovery backup
step.finish.title: You're ready
sources.body: These Safe Sources are already on for the markets you picked. Each card shows its Risk Tier, so you always know how Boba reads it: an official API, a public board or a public feed.
sources.error.load: Your Sources could not be loaded. You can continue; Connections shows them again later.
sources.empty: No Sources are registered yet. Add a feed below, or do it later in Connections.
sources.sessionNote: Session-board sources such as LinkedIn stay off until you opt in for them, with their own ban-risk warning.
sources.changeLater: You can change these later in Connections.
sources.add.title: Add your own feed
sources.add.name: Name (optional)
sources.add.hint: An RSS or Atom feed of job postings. Boba checks that it is a real feed before saving it.
email.body: This step is optional: connect the mailbox Boba sends applications from, or skip it and connect one later in Connections.
email.connected.title: Connected mailboxes
email.addressHint: Type the mailbox address first, then pick Outlook or Gmail.
email.waiting: Finish signing in in your browser. Boba wakes up as soon as you do, and Skip still works if you would rather do this later.
email.noBundledClient.body: This build has no one-click sign-in. Skip for now, or add your own client under Connections > Email.
email.note: More options — IMAP/SMTP and your own OAuth client — are in Connections.
email.error: That connection did not complete. You can try again or skip this step.
backup.intro: Boba keeps your data on this computer, locked with a key in your system keychain. This build is not signed by Apple or Microsoft, so an update can lose that keychain entry.
backup.why: The passphrase-protected backup in this step is how you get your data back if that happens. Keep the file and its passphrase somewhere safe: it is the only copy, and Boba cannot recover your passphrase for you.
backup.loadError: Boba could not check for a recovery backup. Try again before finishing.
backup.required: Create a recovery backup to finish setup. No search run starts until it exists.
backup.beforeFinish: A recovery backup is needed before setup can finish.
backup.create.title: Create the backup
backup.mismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
backup.error: The backup could not be created. Nothing was changed.
finish.body: Here is how Boba will work for you. You can change every one of these later in Settings.
finish.applyMode.title: Apply Mode
finish.applyMode.explanation: Every application waits for your OK before it is sent. Auto-apply is off, and it can only be turned on later in Settings, after its own confirmation.
finish.applyMode.autoWarning: Auto-apply is still on from an earlier setup. Review it in Settings → Applying before you rely on it.
finish.schedule.title: Daily search
finish.schedule.value: Every day at {time}, your local time
finish.schedule.hint: Boba runs the search in the background while you are logged in.
finish.autostart.title: Launch at login
finish.autostart.hint: You can turn it on later if you want Boba ready every morning.
finish.firstRun: Next starts your first Search Run and opens Today with live progress.
